description: This file defines various calculation functions for card properties in a project, including statistical measures like sum, average, median, min, max, and date-related calculations, and exports them as a record.

methods.name: getCardProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value from a card based on property template.

methods.name: fixTimestampToMinutesAccuracy
methods.description: Adjusts timestamp to minute accuracy by removing seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: cardsWithValue
methods.description: Filters cards that have a non-empty value for a given property.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of cards.

methods.name: countEmpty
methods.description: Counts cards with empty or null property values.

methods.name: countNotEmpty
methods.description: Counts cards with non-empty property values.

methods.name: percentEmpty
methods.description: Calculates percentage of cards with empty property values.

methods.name: percentNotEmpty
methods.description: Calculates percentage of cards with non-empty property values.

methods.name: countValueHelper
methods.description: Helper to count total values, including multi-select properties.

methods.name: countValue
methods.description: Counts total property values across cards.

methods.name: countChecked
methods.description: Counts checked items in a property.

methods.name: countUnchecked
methods.description: Counts unchecked items in a property.

methods.name: percentChecked
methods.description: Calculates percentage of checked items.

methods.name: percentUnchecked
methods.description: Calculates percentage of unchecked items.

methods.name: countUniqueValue
methods.description: Counts unique property values across cards.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates sum of numeric property values.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates average of numeric property values.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Calculates median of numeric property values.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Finds minimum value among property values.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Finds maximum value among property values.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Returns the range (min - max) of property values.

methods.name: earliest
methods.description: Finds the earliest date/time from property timestamps.

methods.name: earliestEpoch
methods.description: Gets the earliest epoch timestamp from property values.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Finds the latest date/time from property timestamps.

methods.name: latestEpoch
methods.description: Gets the latest epoch timestamp from property values.

methods.name: getTimestampsFromPropertyValue
methods.description: Extracts timestamps from property value, handling different formats.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Calculates human-readable duration between earliest and latest timestamps.
